titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: Fifteen elephants died in Kenya, with officials suspecting cyanide in tomato pesticide as the cause.

titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Hundreds of migrants swam from Morocco to the Spanish enclave of Ceuta.
An earthquake in southwestern Japan resulted in 25 deaths.
Thousands were evacuated in Crete as wildfires continued.
Spain will send troops to Ceuta to help with border security.
